name: cani
description: Ask before you buy — an auditable YES/NO before money moves. AI owns the conversation; a deterministic, append-only ledger owns the verdict.

paragraphs: A money manager you call from the point of purchase — before the money moves. Upload statements once, confirm what's genuinely committed, then ask "Can I buy this?" and get a hard, explainable verdict: YES or NO you can audit. Not a budget you check on Sunday.
Live demo: — seeded with a demo month (income $8,900 · committed $2,400 · headroom $1,900).
Core invariants (see SPEC.md for the full product spec):
features: The AI never touches the numbers or the verdict. A deterministic,
The ledger is append-only. Corrections are new rows, never edits.
A wrong YES kills the product. Committed payments are human-confirmed;

requirements.text: Deeper mode (engine 0.3.0) — an optional "Who am I → Who I want to be" tree (age band, housing, dependents, US state, goal, horizon, temperament) plus bundled approximate 50-state + DC cost data (src/data/us-states.json, coaching-grade, not live Numbeo).
